title: Setting up your website step by step — all purchased modules in one place
body:
On your first login, a full-screen setup opens: **„Állítsuk be együtt”** (Let's set it up together). It guides
you through every module you have bought — question by question, one at a time. You don't need to know which
menu holds what: you answer, and the system enters it in the right place. What you enter here is the same as if
you had set it up on the module's own page.

![Screenshot: the setup on a phone — the per-room capacity question, with the topics at the top](assets/hu/screen.png)

## How does it go?

1. The first question: how you rent out the property — as a whole, by room, or as a whole while only
   presenting the rooms. Every further question depends on this.
2. If you rent by room, you enter how many rooms you have and what they are called. This creates the rooms;
   the whole house also remains bookable alongside them.
3. Then it asks for capacity and price room by room — a separate question comes for each room.
4. The button takes you to the next question: **„Tovább”** (Next), and at the last question of a topic **„Mentés, tovább”** (Save and continue).

On a phone you see at the top of the page which topic you are at; tapping **„Témák”** (Topics) opens the
full list. Below the question, tapping **„Így látja a vendég”** (How the guest sees it) shows what the guest
sees on your website. On a computer the list of topics is on the left and the guest view on the right —
it updates after every answer.

Some topics are set up on their existing page (for example the Weekly events guide). In that case the setup
opens that page with a button, and a dark bar sits at the top of the page:
**„Kész — vissza a beállításhoz”** (Done — back to the setup). Tapping it continues the setup with the next topic.

## If you got something wrong

You can go back anywhere. **„Vissza”** (Back) takes you to the previous question; at the first question of a topic
the button shows the name of the previous topic and takes you back to its last question. In the list of topics,
every finished topic says: **„Kész — szerkeszthető”** (Done — editable). Clicking it opens it again, with your saved answers.
If, for example, you later decide to rent the house by room after all, the capacity and price questions appear
again room by room.

## If you don't have time now

- **„Később folytatom”** (Continue later): saves where you are. At the top of the Overview, the **„Folytatom”** (Continue) button
  takes you back to where you left off — from another device too.
- **„Kihagyom”** (Skip): moves the topic to the end of the queue; if another topic is waiting for it, it tells you that too.
- **„Most kihagyom”** (Skip for now): for optional topics (for example your own photos) — you can come back to it any time later.

Anything waiting for another topic is shown with a padlock in the list, and says what it is waiting for — for example:
the prices are needed first, because the booking shows an amount.

## If an answer needs a module

If you choose something that needs a module not in your package (for example the Rooms module for renting by room),
the setup tells you which one is needed and what it costs. There are two ways: you order it — then it goes into the
existing module cart, and after payment the setup continues where you left off —, or for now you rent
the property as a whole.

## Where do you see later what is missing?

- At the top of the Overview: how many topics are done, and what comes next. When everything is done, the
  **„Beállítás átnézése”** (Review setup) button in the same place lets you go through any of them again.
- On the Modules tab every topic is a card: green when done, red or yellow when something is missing, and
  it says what is missing — room by room too, for example “1/3 rooms have a price”.
- On the module's own page, the same questions appear at the top if any are still unanswered. With the
  **„Elrejtem”** (Hide) button you can collapse them; a narrow row then remains, and with the **„Folytatom”** (Continue)
  button (for a finished topic **„Átnézem”** (Review)) you can open them again any time.

If for a topic you decide not to give something — for example at the price you tick
**„Ennél nem adok meg árat”** (No price for this one), because you always send a custom quote —, that is not a gap: the card says
**„Ön döntött így”** (You chose this), and we won't remind you about it again.
